known_secrets.text: I have repeatedly returned to a high forest zone where animal trails form unnatural convergence patterns.
These patterns sometimes align with old terrace directions near the monument.
I did not initially realize this correlation.
I have started mapping it privately.
Certain paths appear only under specific weather or light conditions.
Bran would consider these areas wrong.
I agree, but I still go there.
Kiri and I once followed a trail that ended at a sealed stone structure embedded in terrain.
It was not recorded in any village knowledge.
We did not fully inspect it.
